description: This file defines the `torch.nn.modules.sparse` module, specifically implementing the `Embedding` and `EmbeddingBag` classes, which are used for lookup table embeddings in neural networks within the PyTorch framework. It includes class definitions, methods for initialization, forward passes, and utility functions, along with detailed docstrings.

classes.name: Embedding
classes.description: A module implementing a lookup table that stores fixed-size embeddings for a dictionary of items, typically used for word embeddings or similar applications.

classes.name: EmbeddingBag
classes.description: A module that computes sums or means of 'bags' of embeddings efficiently, supporting per-sample weights and different reduction modes.

methods.name: Embedding.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Embedding layer with specified parameters such as number of embeddings, embedding dimension, padding index, max norm, and others.

methods.name: Embedding.reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes the embedding weights using a normal distribution and zeroes out the padding index if specified.

methods.name: Embedding._fill_padding_idx_with_zero
methods.description: Sets the embedding vector at the padding index to zeros, if padding is used.

methods.name: Embedding.forward
methods.description: Performs the embedding lookup for the given input tensor of indices.

methods.name: Embedding.extra_repr
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the Layer's configuration.

methods.name: Embedding.from_pretrained
methods.description: Creates an Embedding instance from a pre-trained weight tensor, optionally freezing weights and setting padding indices.

methods.name: EmbeddingBag.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the EmbeddingBag layer with parameters such as number of embeddings, embedding dimension, mode, padding index, and others.

methods.name: EmbeddingBag.reset_parameters
methods.description: Initializes the embedding weights using a normal distribution and zeroes out the padding index if specified.

methods.name: EmbeddingBag._fill_padding_idx_with_zero
methods.description: Sets the embedding vector at the padding index to zeros.

methods.name: EmbeddingBag.forward
methods.description: Performs a forward pass computing embeddings for bags of indices, supporting per-sample weights and multiple reduction modes.
